title: Platform Settings
description: Manage general brand settings, contact details, Egyptian payment methods, and owner password.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Platform brand name and guarantee period shown across the storefront.
general.guaranteeDaysHint: Non-negative integer number of support/guarantee days.
general.registrationEnabledHint: When turned off, visitors cannot create new customer accounts, while existing accounts and guest checkout remain active.

contact.title: Contact Information & Social Links
contact.description: Public contact channels displayed in the footer and contact page.
contact.whatsappPlaceholder: Enter WhatsApp number with country code
contact.phonePlaceholder: Enter phone number with country code

payments.title: Payment Methods
payments.description: Enable and configure manual and gateway payment methods available at checkout.

vodafone.title: Vodafone Cash
vodafone.description: Manual wallet transfer with payment receipt upload and owner review.

instapay.title: InstaPay
instapay.description: Instant transfer to your InstaPay Payment Address (IPA) with receipt verification.

fawry.title: Fawry
fawry.description: Generate Fawry kiosk reference codes via Paymob integration.
fawry.serverNote: Paymob Fawry gateway credentials are configured on the server.
fawry.unavailableNote: Disabled because Paymob Fawry keys (PAYMOB_API_KEY, PAYMOB_FAWRY_INTEGRATION_ID, PAYMOB_HMAC_SECRET) are not configured on the server. Hidden from checkout.

card.title: Bank Cards
card.description: Online Visa & Mastercard checkout via Paymob iFrame.
card.serverNote: Paymob Card gateway credentials are configured on the server.
card.unavailableNote: Disabled because Paymob Card keys (PAYMOB_API_KEY, PAYMOB_CARD_INTEGRATION_ID, PAYMOB_IFRAME_ID, PAYMOB_HMAC_SECRET) are not configured on the server. Hidden from checkout.

security.title: Account Security & Change Password
security.description: Update your owner console password. Your current password is required to confirm.
security.newPasswordHint: New password must be at least 8 characters long.

validation.guaranteeDaysInteger: Guarantee days must be a whole number
validation.guaranteeDaysMin: Guarantee days must be 0 or greater
validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
validation.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
validation.newPasswordMin: New password must be at least 8 characters long

error.title: Failed to load settings
error.description: An error occurred while loading platform settings. Please try again.
